annotations.description: Fires while any device has a WARNING or CRITICAL issue opened, escalated or reminded in the last 2 minutes. Route it to a contact point in Alerting > Notification policies.

model.rawSql:
SELECT device_id, kind, severity, count(*)::float AS value
FROM issue_events
WHERE time > now() - interval '2 minutes'
  AND event IN ('opened', 'escalated', 'reminder')
  AND severity IN ('WARNING', 'CRITICAL')
GROUP BY device_id, kind, severity
